name: Exp_ColorMETRO_Stochastic
summary: This EA trades based on crossover signals from the ColorMETRO_Stochastic custom indicator, which applies step-size filtering to a Stochastic oscillator. It opens buy positions when the Stochastic main line crosses above the signal line and sell positions when it crosses below, with configurable position closing on reverse signals.
summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorMETRO_Stochastic自定义指标的交叉信号进行交易，该指标对随机振荡器应用步长过滤。当随机指标主线从下方穿越信号线时开多仓，从上方穿越时开空仓，并可在反向信号时平仓。
strategy_analysis: 策略核心是基于步长过滤的随机指标(ColorMETRO_Stochastic)的交叉信号交易系统。入场条件：当MPlus线从下方穿越MMinus线时产生买入信号，当MPlus线从上方穿越MMinus线时产生卖出信号，信号确认需要前一根K线上MPlus和MMinus存在明确的大小关系且当前K线发生交叉。出场条件：反向交叉信号触发平仓，同时设置了固定的止损(1000点)和止盈(2000点)。仓位管理采用Lot模式直接指定手数，但也支持基于余额、净值等百分比的资金管理模式。信号仅在 新K线 时计算，避免重复交易。步长参数(StepSizeFast=5, StepSizeSlow=15)对随机指标值进行量化过滤，减少虚假信号。整体策略属于动量跟踪类型，跟随随机指标的交叉方向入场。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy core is a crossover signal trading system based on a step-filtered Stochastic oscillator (ColorMETRO_Stochastic). Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when the MPlus line crosses above the MMinus line, and a sell signal is generated when the MPlus line crosses below the MMinus line, requiring a clear directional relationship on the previous bar and a crossover on the current bar. Exit conditions: reverse crossover signals trigger position closing, with fixed StopLoss (1000 points) and TakeProfit (2000 points) also configured. Position sizing defaults to direct lot specification (LOT mode), but also supports percentage-based money management modes including balance, free margin, and loss-adjusted variants. Signals are only calculated on new bars via the IsNewBar mechanism, preventing duplicate trades. The step size parameters (StepSizeFast=5, StepSizeSlow=15) quantize the Stochastic values to reduce false signals. The overall strategy is a momentum-following type, entering in the direction of Stochastic crossovers.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金管理参数，交易手数或百分比系数
parameters.description_en: Money management parameter, lot size or percentage coefficient

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 资金管理模式：固定手数、按余额比例、按净值比例等
parameters.description_en: Money management mode: fixed lot, balance percentage, free margin percentage, etc.

parameters.name: BuyPosClose
parameters.description: 是否在反向信号时平多仓
parameters.description_en: Enable buy position closing on reverse signal

parameters.name: SellPosClose
parameters.description: 是否在反向信号时平空仓
parameters.description_en: Enable sell position closing on reverse signal

parameters.name: DPeriod
parameters.description: 随机指标D周期(信号线平滑周期)
parameters.description_en: Stochastic D period (signal line smoothing period)

parameters.name: Slowing
parameters.description: 随机指标减速/平滑参数

parameters.name: MA_Method
parameters.description_en: Moving average method for Stochastic calculation

parameters.name: StepSizeFast
parameters.description: 快速步长过滤参数，量化随机指标值以减少噪音
parameters.description_en: Fast step size filter parameter, quantizes Stochastic values to reduce noise

parameters.name: StepSizeSlow
parameters.description: 慢速步长过滤参数，更大的步长产生更平滑的信号
parameters.description_en: Slow step size filter parameter, larger step produces smoother signals

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 用于信号判断的K线索引，1为前一根已收盘K线
parameters.description_en: Bar index for signal evaluation, 1 = previous closed bar

pros: 使用步长过滤的随机指标，有效减少虚假信号和频繁交易
支持多种资金管理模式，灵活度高
新K线机制防止同一根K线内重复开仓
止损止盈参数齐全，风险可控
买卖方向可独立开关，便于单向交易或对冲测试
pros_en: Step-filtered Stochastic effectively reduces false signals and over-trading
Multiple money management modes provide flexibility
New bar mechanism prevents duplicate entries within the same bar
Complete stop loss and take profit parameters for risk control
Buy and sell directions can be independently enabled/disabled for flexible testing
cons: 止损1000点和止盈2000点默认值过大，对多数品种不合适
缺乏点差过滤，在点差较大时可能不利
没有持仓检查逻辑，可能重复开仓
依赖自定义指标ColorMETRO_Stochastic，指标文件缺失则EA无法运行
信号仅在交叉时触发，震荡行情中可能频繁进出场
cons_en: Default StopLoss=1000 and TakeProfit=2000 points are excessively large for most instruments
No spread filter, which may cause unfavorable entries during high-spread conditions
No open position check before opening new trades, risking duplicate positions
Depends on custom indicator ColorMETRO_Stochastic, EA fails if indicator file is missing
Signals only trigger on crossovers, potentially causing frequent entries and exits in ranging markets
improvements: 增加持仓检查逻辑，避免同方向重复开仓
添加点差过滤和交易时段过滤，提高入场质量
improvements_en: Add open position check logic to prevent duplicate entries in the same direction
Add spread filter and trading session filter to improve entry quality

risk_points: 没有持仓检查，可能在已有同方向持仓时重复开仓
默认止损止盈值偏大，可能导致单笔亏损过大
缺乏点差过滤，高点差环境下入场成本高
risk_points_en: No position check before opening trades, may duplicate positions in the same direction
Default stop loss/take profit values are large, potentially causing significant single-trade losses
No spread filter, high entry cost in wide-spread environments

It opens buy positions when the Stochastic main line crosses above the signal line and sell positions when it crosses below, with configurable position closing on reverse signals.
